name: Inkou Club
source:
Yuriko just lives a peaceful life with her husband and son. But one day, her life dramatically changes when she joins the "club." In front of her, a strange man appears and her husband says to him, "Sleep with my wife...." What will happen to her...? What is his intention...?

[From ErogeShop]
